llm.summary: The skill is a clearly scoped remote cosmetic-ingredient compliance checker, with the main privacy consideration being that formulation data is sent to its disclosed external service.

dimensions.detail: Network submission and an x402 payment hash are proportionate to a paid remote compliance-checking service, but cosmetic formulations can be proprietary business data.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact consists only of a Markdown SKILL.md with frontmatter; no executable scripts, package installs, hooks, or local setup steps are present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The use cases are narrowly described for cosmetic formulas and EU market access, and there are no role-change, prompt-override, or hidden agent-control instructions; however, the artifact does not include a separate plain-language privacy or retention disclosure.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, local credential access, background workers, memory writes, or local file mutation are requested.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is EU cosmetic formulation compliance checking, and the capability described is a fixed POST request that submits ingredients, markets, and a payment hash to a compliance endpoint.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending ingredient lists, market selections, and a Solana payment transaction signature to the disclosed external service. Avoid submitting confidential or unreleased formulations unless you trust the provider and have checked its privacy, retention, and legal-review practices.
llm.findings: [SQP-2] expected: The scanner concern is supported in part because ingredient formulations are sent to a third-party endpoint and could be sensitive, but the endpoint, method, body schema, and payment field are explicitly disclosed in the skill; this is best handled as user guidance rather than a Review verdict.
